title: TLDR Astro Phrase Bank Entry
description: Schema for every authored/templated entry in the phrase bank. Entries are keyed by a cc/ source id and belong to exactly one lane.

lane.description: exact = primary interpretive source; context = supporting/refine only; keyword = metadata only, never prose.

surface_scope.description: Surfaces this entry is allowed to feed. Enforces that collective and personalized entries do not share a fallback paragraph.

authored.description: true = hand-authored copy; false = templated slot with variables.

card.description: Compact copy: ONE concise claim for the card/list view. Must NOT be identical to `detail` (rule 8: compact and expanded copy are separated).

detail.description: Expanded copy: the developed interpretation for the detail page.

state.description: Publication state. Only READER_READY entries may render to a reader. Missing primary source -> SOURCE_GAP.

situation.description: The one recognizable lived situation. For exact-lane entries this is load-bearing.

bridge.description: Optional interpretive bridge. Suppressed if it only restates the situation.

refine.description: Context-lane only: a clause that REFINES an exact reading. May not stand alone as a sentence.

footer_terms.description: Immutable technical astrology facts to render last (transit cards).

template.description: For templated entries: a string with {slots}. Slots draw from other bank records, never from raw keywords.

variables.description: Named variables a template consumes, each mapped to an allowed source lane.

keywords.description: Metadata only. NEVER concatenated into prose.

sect_gated.description: If true, copy is suppressed unless birth time + horizon are reliable.

then.description: Context records may not carry an independent 'situation' sentence.
